design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used multiple plausible values and applied Rubin's rules for handling them.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that student weights were used in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employed hierarchical linear modeling (HLM), which accounts for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): Using data from 32 OECD countries from the latest cycle of PISA 2018 reading dataset, this study combines an AI algorithm and hierarchical linear modeling (HLM) to examine effects of ICT-related factors on students’ reading performance.
